Any expiry, wait, PASS awaiting later evidence, abort, FAIL, BLOCKED, or completion has every inapplicable flag false.

abort_condition_contract.failure_classification_rule: derive all observed classes before selecting the terminal. SAFETY is present for any Voice, unapproved/operator database mutation, unlisted or unexpected effect, provider/credential mutation, history rewrite, raw private content, or restoration failure/unknown. CONTROL_HEAD_DRIFT is present for any control/main/candidate/packet/head conflict. BUDGET is present for cost, spend, attempt, call, packet, window, active-clock, or absolute-clock overrun. SCOPE is present for authorization/scope drift. INFRA and EVIDENCE follow the exact provider/status default map. Choose the first present class in failure_classification_precedence and require the packet trigger and terminal state for that class; no evaluator-invented or caller-selected alternative is accepted.
abort_condition_contract.rule: packet abort_conditions exactly equals the gate's required ordered rows; every class is present once, terminal_state follows the class map, and evidence_required is true. Every terminal result abort_trigger_id and terminal_state must match one packet row and bind canonical failure evidence; no omitted, weakened, caller-invented, or post-hoc trigger is accepted.

required_actions: execute only exact bound provider or credential preflight and mutation entries
deploy and promote exact Vercel candidate last
execute bound reverse rollback only on an abort trigger

provider_mutation_contract.opaque_old_state_ref_rule: must be a confidential_reference_contract object; raw values, raw provider payloads, digests of guessable secrets, and arbitrary strings are prohibited
provider_mutation_contract.rollback_rule: operation descriptor plus canonical confidential rollback-state reference only; never an embedded setting or credential value
provider_mutation_contract.rollback_state_lifetime_rule: opaque_old_state_ref and rollback.confidential_state_ref are the same exact confidential reference object; rollback_state_valid_through equals both objects' expires_at. They must be resolvable and unexpired at packet presentation and consumption, immediately before mutation, and immediately before reversal. rollback_state_valid_through must be later than max(packet.expires_at, mission absolute_expires_at) by at least safety_reversal_horizon_seconds and later than every mutation/reversal timestamp; otherwise the mutation is not authorized.

required_actions: execute the first frozen text-only M00 provider call only after approval consumption
execute exactly one frozen text-only M00 attempt
seal PASS or FAIL M00 outcome
only after sealed M00 PASS execute and seal one exact no-retry 19-selector generic live-client release lane under its separately bound sub-budget
required_exclusions: unapproved or operator database DDL/DML/migration/control-plane mutation

required_actions: merge exact integration candidate without rebase
perform only listed text-production canonical actions

structured_action_contract.final_pr_binding_rule: packet.bindings.final_pr_identity, d3_integration_candidate.final_pr metadata fields, and main_merge_actions.final_pr_number/head/base/metadata_receipt are exactly equal; the typed metadata receipt proves the remote PR is open, unmerged, based on the bound current main, headed by the exact integration SHA/tree, and pr_number is not 144

canonical_deployment_required_values.future_deployment_ids_rule: exactly one row per target with value JSON null and null_reason ASSIGNED_AFTER_APPROVED_ACTION

production_health_and_identities_contrac.rule: exact target map derived from the validated refreshed POST_M00 provider overlay/health/baseline; deployed ID/source equal the M00-tested repair candidate state and rollback ID/source remain selectable. Every D3 provider action and target rollback receipt crossbinds these identities; no source or rollback identity may be invented after approval.

d1_deployment_result.closure_rule: PASS requires all three assigned identities, all three still-selectable rollback identities, health and route closure, no abort, and no rollback. Actual mutation lists equal the approved D1 lists; elapsed/cost/actions remain within the bound manifests.
d1_deployment_result.target_attempt_rule: PASS requires LangGraph=1, Gateway=1, and Vercel=1. ABORTED_BLOCKED requires each count be 0 or 1 and the exact attempted deployment prefix derived from ordered_action_receipts; no later target may be counted after an uncompleted earlier target.

abort_terminal_rule.attempt_and_identity_rule: target_attempts is the exact 0/1 attempted deployment prefix. production_deployments and promotions derive from APPLIED/PARTIALLY_APPLIED action rows. assigned_identities has exact target keys; an unassigned value is JSON null with assigned_identity_null_reasons[target] equal NOT_ASSIGNED_DUE_TO_BOUND_ABORT or PROVIDER_DID_NOT_ASSIGN_BEFORE_BOUND_ABORT, while every assigned value is nonempty and its reason is null. rollback_identities remain all three nonempty preapproved identities.
abort_terminal_rule.post_deploy_partial_rule: each post-deploy proof field is either a canonical produced reference with matching null reason or JSON null with post_deploy_proof_null_reasons[field]=NOT_REACHED_DUE_TO_BOUND_ABORT. route_edges_passed is the truthful integer 0..8; hmac_challenge_status is PASS_ZERO_DML only if proved, otherwise NOT_REACHED_DUE_TO_BOUND_ABORT. No missing fact is converted to PASS.
abort_terminal_rule.incident_observation_rule: authorization hard-zeros Voice, database mutation, unlisted action, time overage, and cost overage. If one nevertheless occurs, ABORTED_BLOCKED retains the truthful observed value and bound evidence; a safety event requires BLOCKED_SAFETY and a time/cost overage requires BLOCKED_BUDGET unless a failed restoration is more severe. Forward action stops and the evidence is not permission.
abort_terminal_rule.rollback_derivation_rule: reverse the exact successfully changed deployment-target prefix from ordered action receipts; include a partially changed failing target only when its provider receipt proves mutation; never roll back an untouched target
abort_terminal_rule.reversal_order: after service rollback, reverse the executed mutation entries in exact reverse execution order

d1_deployment_result.mutation_execution_rule: PASS has exactly one ordered row per approved mutation entry, first every provider_setting_mutations entry then every credential_mutations entry, and actual mutation lists equal the full approved lists. ABORTED_BLOCKED has the exact attempted approved prefix and its actual mutation lists equal only those attempted entries. Each row repeats target/name/operation from its indexed approved entry; effect_state is APPLIED, NO_EFFECT, or PARTIALLY_APPLIED. All mutation rows are temporally contained within the first BOUND_PREFLIGHT_OR_EXACT_MUTATIONS forward-action receipt. A FAIL mutation row is the last attempted mutation and no later mutation or forward envelope may run. Its typed mutation evidence contains the exact nested d1_action_failure_evidence; the gate_abort_incident bound by result.abort_failure_ref names that mutation evidence as source_action_ref or cause_ref and recomputes the final trigger across every cause, so a later restoration failure may elevate the terminal to SAFETY without rewriting the earlier receipt. The three different typed receipts never claim byte equality. Reversal receipts biject only to APPLIED/PARTIALLY_APPLIED effects in reverse order.
d1_deployment_result.mutation_reversal_rule: ABORTED_BLOCKED mutation_reversal_receipts are the complete ordered bijection to mutation_execution_receipts whose effect_state is APPLIED or PARTIALLY_APPLIED, in reverse original sequence after every derived service-rollback attempt; every row repeats the original kind/target/name and uses only the preapproved rollback.operation. Attempted rows have real ordered timestamps, canonical evidence_ref, null not_run_reason_ref, APPLIED/NO_EFFECT/PARTIALLY_APPLIED effect_state, and PASS/FAIL; PASS requires APPLIED. A later reversal that cannot safely run after an earlier failure has null timestamps/evidence_ref, canonical not_run_reason_ref, effect_state NOT_RUN, and result NOT_RUN. Any FAIL/NOT_RUN requires terminal_state=BLOCKED_SAFETY, failure rollback_status, and no restoration claim. Already-bound reversal remains authorized after window/clock expiry solely to restore safety; no new forward action may accompany it. PASS deployment requires an empty list.
d1_deployment_result.rollback_receipt_rule: ABORTED_BLOCKED service rollback rows are an exact ordered bijection to the reversible changed deployment-target prefix in reverse order; no untouched target appears. Attempted rows have real timestamps, canonical provider_receipt_ref, null not_run_reason_ref, APPLIED/NO_EFFECT/PARTIALLY_APPLIED effect_state, and PASS/FAIL; PASS requires APPLIED. A later rollback that cannot safely run after an earlier failure has null timestamps/provider_receipt_ref, canonical not_run_reason_ref, effect_state NOT_RUN, and result NOT_RUN. Any FAIL/NOT_RUN requires terminal_state=BLOCKED_SAFETY and no restoration claim. Already-bound rollback remains authorized after window/clock expiry solely to restore safety; no new forward action may accompany it.
d1_deployment_result.rollback_status_rule: PASS is NOT_TRIGGERED. ABORTED_BLOCKED with no APPLIED/PARTIALLY_APPLIED deployment or mutation effect is NO_CHANGED_EFFECT. Exact complete PASS rollback/reversal coverage is ALL_CHANGED_EFFECTS_RESTORED. Any FAIL, NOT_RUN, missing proof, or identity mismatch is RESTORATION_FAILED_OR_UNKNOWN and forces BLOCKED_SAFETY; no weaker restoration claim is accepted.
d1_deployment_result.ordered_action_receipt_rule: PASS requires exactly five forward receipt rows bijecting to the approved forward action envelopes, inside the approved window/clocks, all result PASS; the preflight envelope is APPLIED iff an approved mutation applied and otherwise NO_EFFECT, each deployment/promotion is APPLIED, and verification is NO_EFFECT. ABORTED_BLOCKED requires the exact executed forward prefix; a between-action abort may end with PASS, while an action failure retains its FAIL row. Service rollback derives only from deployment rows with APPLIED/PARTIALLY_APPLIED effect_state, the bound trigger/failing receipt is retained, and exact reverse rollback receipts cover every attempted rollback; it may not claim completion.
d1_deployment_result.cost_and_elapsed_rule: every cost_usd is finite nonnegative and equals its typed evidence receipt; the preflight row cost equals the sum of mutation-execution costs and is counted only once. actual_cost_usd equals the sum of forward-row costs plus attempted service-rollback and mutation-reversal costs. elapsed_minutes equals exact minutes from D1 consumption consumed_at through result.created_at. PASS remains within packet cost/window; ABORT retains any truthful overage and maps it to BLOCKED_BUDGET unless a restoration/safety failure takes precedence.

d1_forward_action_evidence.rule: packet/consumption/candidate and step/target/operation equal the parent ordered action row and approved action manifest. Deployment/promotion PASS rows bind the exact approved source, current/resulting/rollback identities, nonnull opaque provider receipt ID/digest, null provider reason and null failure ref. Provider FAIL rows have a typed failure ref and provider ID/digest either both nonnull with null reason or both null with NO_PROVIDER_RECEIPT_AVAILABLE_DUE_TO_PRE_RESPONSE_FAILURE. Preflight/verification rows, whether PASS or FAIL, use JSON-null approved source and identity fields with identity_null_reason NOT_APPLICABLE_NON_PROVIDER_ENVELOPE. A non-provider PASS additionally has JSON-null provider/failure fields and provider reason NOT_APPLICABLE_NON_PROVIDER_ENVELOPE; a non-provider FAIL has JSON-null provider ID/digest, provider reason NOT_APPLICABLE_NON_PROVIDER_ENVELOPE_FAILURE, and a typed failure ref. effect_state/result/timestamps exactly equal the parent row. Provider payloads, credentials, and user data are prohibited.

d1_mutation_effect_evidence.rule: all identity/action fields exactly equal the approved indexed mutation and parent execution row; prestate_confidential_ref equals the packet mutation opaque_old_state_ref/rollback confidential_state_ref and remains valid through ended_at and the safety horizon. PASS has nonnull opaque provider ID/digest, null provider reason and failure ref. FAIL has a typed failure ref and the provider tuple follows the exact all-or-none pre-response null convention. effect_state/result/timestamps equal the parent; no secret value, value hash, or raw provider payload is stored.

d1_service_rollback_evidence.rule: target/operation/timestamps/cost/effect_state/result equal the parent rollback row; changed and rollback identities derive from the exact changed forward action and packet overlay. PASS requires effect_state APPLIED, resulting_identity equal approved_rollback_identity, identity/provider null reasons and failure ref JSON null, and nonnull provider ID/digest. FAIL retains a null or observed resulting identity with exact failure reason, carries typed failure evidence, uses the exact all-or-none provider tuple convention, and never claims restoration.

d1_mutation_reversal_evidence.rule: original mutation and all indexed fields including cost/effect_state equal the parent reversal row and approved rollback descriptor; rollback_state_confidential_ref equals the still-valid packet prestate reference. PASS requires effect_state APPLIED and restoration_status RESTORED_TO_BOUND_PRESTATE with nonnull provider ID/digest and null reasons/failure ref. FAIL is RESTORATION_FAILED_OR_UNKNOWN with typed failure evidence and the exact all-or-none provider tuple convention. No raw state or credential value is stored.

d1_action_failure_evidence.rule: packet/consumption/action/target/operation/effect/timestamps equal the enclosing failed receipt. abort_trigger_id is the exact packet abort condition deterministically selected from the status/facts observable when this failure receipt is sealed; it never predicts a later rollback or reversal outcome. Provider ID/digest are both nonnull with null reason JSON null, or both JSON null with one declared provider_receipt_null_reason_value; NOT_APPLICABLE_NON_PROVIDER_ENVELOPE_FAILURE is permitted only for a failed preflight/verification envelope, and the tuple exactly equals the enclosing typed receipt. The final gate_abort_incident includes this receipt in source_action_ref or cause_refs and recomputes precedence across every cause; its/result trigger equals this contemporaneous trigger only when no later or simultaneous higher-precedence fact changes the final class. No raw provider response, credential, private content, or free-form failure payload is stored.

gate_abort_incident.rule: gate/candidate/packet/consumption/trigger exactly bind the affected transaction and one required packet abort row. observed_facts uses exact int-not-bool/finite values; at least one fact is nonzero or true. condition_class and terminal_state are deterministically derived by abort_condition_contract.failure_classification_rule, with safety/restoration precedence. source_action_ref is canonical when an action or restoration receipt exists. Otherwise it is JSON null and source_position must be one of source_action_null_reason_by_source_position with the exact mapped reason; DURING_ACTION and DURING_BOUND_SAFETY_RESTORATION always require a typed source action. cause_refs is a nonempty unique ordered list of canonical immutable evidence preceding this incident. No raw provider response, private content, credential, database coordinate, user data, or free-form payload is retained.

d1_safety_not_run_reason.rule: used only after a preceding rollback/reversal FAIL makes the later bound restoration unsafe; prior_failure_ref is the exact failed receipt, trigger matches the packet abort condition, and no forward authority is created

d1_confidential_prerequisites.disposition_bijection_rule: actual secret_dispositions and tracked_record_dispositions are exact one-row-per-template bijections with unique group_id and unique nonnull confidential_ref; every ref validates under confidential_reference_contract and ref.result equals row.result equals PASS; missing, duplicate, shared, expired, or unresolved coverage is BLOCKED_EVIDENCE

Later route/health overlays preserve the same service/project and candidate source identities while adding assigned/fresh provider observations. d1_m00_data_contract.confidential_ref_union_rule: opaque_confidential_receipt_refs is the exact unique union of all 17 relation, 51 routine, database-project, storage, role/membership, and advisor component refs; every ref validates under confidential_reference_contract and no component may borrow or omit another component's proof
d1_m00_data_contract.inventory_row_derivation_rule: load source_contracts[0] at its exact path and SHA-256. relation disposition_rows is an exact ordered bijection to confidential-disposition-index.json.relation_acl_contract; relation equals source relation and immutable_contract_row_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes of that exact source row. routine disposition_rows is an exact ordered concatenation of routine_inventory.active_service_rpc, retained_owner_only_legacy, and constraint_helper_owner_only; regprocedure_signature and routine_class equal the source key/value and immutable_contract_row_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes of {regprocedure_signature,routine_class}. Each row result is PASS, every confidential_ref validates under confidential_reference_contract, and disposition_refs exactly equals the ordered projection of row confidential_ref values. No duplicate relation, signature, class, digest, or confidential reference is accepted.
d1_m00_data_contract.inventory_rule: relations and exact regprocedure signatures/classes equal the immutable 17-relation and 51-routine source inventories; every row has a digest-bound confidential result and no missing, duplicate, renamed, class-swapped, or count-only substitution is accepted

m00_route_closure.identity_binding_rule: FC01-D1 binds the static target-plan overlay and uses the exact null phase-boundary convention. FC01-D2 binds the unique deeply validated D1 PASS result and POST_M00 binds the unique deeply validated 19-of-19 live PASS result; phase_boundary_ref, phase_boundary_at, and null reason exactly follow phase_boundary_contract_by_gate. Both live phases bind the exact phase-matching provider_identity_overlay, and every edge observed_at is at or after that phase boundary. m00_route_edge_evidence.rule: gate/phase/candidate/phase-boundary/edge/proof mode equal the parent route row; phase-boundary fields follow the parent's exact gate dispatch, proof_mode and status_code_or_result equal the exact phase/edge maps, and result is PASS. Participating source/target deployment and source identities equal the phase-matching provider overlay. EDGE-ZERO-VOICE uses exact null identity convention, ZERO_CALLS_OBSERVED, and voice_calls=0. Parent source_anchor_refs are the exact unique ordered canonical anchors from the matching immutable m00-deployment-set edge and candidate source/config bytes; they cannot be arbitrary or borrowed across edges. Raw URLs, credentials, database coordinates, and provider payloads are prohibited.

m00_prerequisite_phase_ledger.pending_reference_rule: evidence_ref is JSON null only for an exact pending chain phase, with nonempty evidence_ref_null_reason and expected_gate; every PASS row has a canonical nonnull path+sha reference. The post-consumption evaluator, never the preapproval manifest, derives the applicable gate-chain row PASS.
m00_prerequisite_phase_ledger.bijection_rule: rows are an exact ID and original-boundary bijection to the 37 Amendment A M00_PREREQUISITE records; no count-only or self-certified gate approval is accepted

d1_repair_budget_ledger.changed_causal_variables_by_cycle_rule: canonical sorted object mapping each exact '<invariant_id>#<cycle_number>' key to the identical nonempty scalar cycle_rows.causal_variable; no missing or extra key
d1_repair_budget_ledger.cycle_history_rule: cycle_rows uses cycle_row_exact_fields and is an exact ordered bijection to scoped candidate commits after the initial sweep; cycles_by_invariant and changed_causal_variables_by_cycle are derived summaries, cycle_number per invariant is at most 2, aggregate candidate revisions are at most 2, and each row names exactly one causal variable with both canonical direct test references

d1_repair_aggregate.per_repair_proof_reference_rule: source_diff_ref and direct_test_proof_ref are unique canonical committed add-only path+sha references; each source diff is a canonical name/status/mode/blob manifest limited to that repair ID's exact immutable Amendment A paths/anchors, and each direct-test receipt uses the exact deterministic selector/assertion set for that ID; one receipt may not be reused across repair IDs
d1_repair_aggregate.per_repair_rule: every exact repair ID has a canonical source-diff and deterministic direct-test proof; no aggregate PASS may hide a failed, skipped, unknown, or missing repair

repair_source_diff_proof.mapping_rule: repair_id is one of the exact ten; rows equal the Git diff object records, remain limited to that ID's immutable Amendment A product/test authorization, and include at least one changed blob from that repair ID's allowed_product_paths. Required test files need not be modified when existing assertions prove the repair, but all are executed by the direct-test proof. Shared test-path changes cannot substitute for or be causally attributed as the product repair, and no receipt is reused.

This deliberately runs every test in each authorized required file so a trivial added selector cannot replace the required assertions. outcome_refs form an ordered one-to-one mapping to selector_ids and commands; the environment ref and every outcome ref are canonical, deeply validated, candidate-bound, introduced before this proof, unique to this repair proof, and no receipt is reused

repair_test_environment_identity.toolchain_and_lock_rule: python_version is exact Python 3.12.x; uv_version is nonempty and comes from the invoked uv runtime; dependency_lock_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the exact candidate backend/uv.lock Git blob; operating_system/architecture are nonempty; working_directory is backend; network is denied
repair_test_environment_identity.privacy_rule: records only toolchain, lock, platform, working-directory, and environment-variable-name identity; values, credentials, user data, and raw provider payloads are prohibited

repair_test_execution_result.rule: candidate SHA/tree and repair_id equal the parent proof; selector_id and command equal the same-position parent selector/command; environment_identity_ref equals the parent environment reference and validates as repair_test_environment_identity; duration is finite and nonnegative; output_sha256 is SHA-256; artifact_ref is canonical and introduced first; logical_outcome_count is a positive integer; timestamps are ordered; no hidden retry, skip, error, unknown, or placeholder command

test_execution_result.rule: all integer fields are exact int-not-bool; candidate/gate/selector/command/environment equal the parent aggregate row; timestamps and duration agree; collected/passed/logical counts are positive and internally consistent; every artifact ref precedes the receipt; stdout_or_junit_sha256 matches the exact retained minimized output/JUnit artifact; no hidden retry, skip, error, unknown, placeholder, or caller-substituted command

test_execution_artifact.rule: parent candidate/gate/repair-or-null/selector/command/environment/timestamps/counts/output digest match exactly. minimized_output_ref resolves to test_minimized_output; its canonical JSON bytes are parsed and every count/result/candidate/selector/command digest equals this wrapper, and output_sha256 equals the reference SHA-256. repair_id is an exact repair ID only for repair-direct tests and otherwise JSON null. Secrets, environment values, user data, raw provider payloads, and absolute private paths are prohibited.

test_minimized_output.rule: canonical JSON is the deterministic minimized parser output for the completed command. All counts are exact int-not-bool, collected_count and passed_count are positive and internally consistent, command_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact parent command UTF-8 bytes, candidate/gate/repair/selector equal both parents, and every count/result equals both test_execution_artifact and test_execution_result (or repair_test_execution_result). No raw stdout, secret, private path, payload, user data, environment value, or unbounded free text is present.

test_environment_identity.lane_rule: gate/candidate equal the parent aggregate execution and environment_class is the exact selector_environment_class_map value. Toolchain rows form an exact unique set covering required_tools_by_environment_class, with no caller-substituted aggregate. Dependency-lock refs equal the candidate Git blobs at the exact required paths. test_environment_identity.privacy_rule: only platform/toolchain/version, lock-file, root/container/browser identity, network mode, and environment-variable-name digests are retained; environment values, credentials, user data, database coordinates, and raw provider payloads are prohibited

test_toolchain_identity.rule: candidate/gate/class/tool/version equal the parent environment row; executable digest and immutable provenance evidence prove the actual invoked binary/package without recording environment values or credentials

test_candidate_lock_identity.rule: candidate_path is an exact class-required path; git_blob and SHA-256 recompute from the candidate Git object and equal the parent lock row; no generated or workspace-substituted dependency graph is accepted

lane_executor_mode_contract.ROOT_NETWORK_NAMESPACE_CAPTURED: the privileged sealed parent applies the ROOT_CAPTURED identity/capability ceiling inside the same fresh loopback-only network namespace and common protected mount/PID namespace used by NETWORK_NAMESPACE_CAPTURED. It proves no nonloopback interface/route before invoking the sealed command memfd exactly once as uid/euid/gid 0. The disposable PostgreSQL service is reachable only through the narrow Unix broker; no host/container socket or external network path is exposed.
lane_executor_mode_contract.rule: the root-owned evaluator implements every setup/lane mode as fixed argv and Linux namespace construction without shell interpolation of runner values. It uses a fresh private mount and PID namespace with a private /proc; bind-remounts the staged evaluator directory, runtime-state directory, detached control worktree, and nested control checkout recursively read-only; replaces /run with a nodev,nosuid,noexec private tmpfs; exposes no host Unix control socket; and closes every inherited fd except stdio, the sealed command memfd, and sealed-parent capture pipes. Candidate/dependency/package/test/build children receive an env-i equivalent containing only present allowlisted names; GITHUB_ACTIONS is only the literal boolean marker. All ACTIONS_ credentials, OIDC/runtime/cache/artifact tokens, repository/provider credentials, environment files, proxy credentials, secret-like names, host Docker/containerd sockets, and unlisted values are absent. A PostgreSQL profile receives only the sealed docker client talking to the exact disposable-Postgres broker, never the host Docker socket. The parent rejects a missing/duplicate tool, unsafe HOME/PATH component, secret-like environment name, nonnumeric uid/gid, mount/capability/socket drift, command digest mismatch, output limit, child retry, surviving descendant, protected-state mutation, or exit-code mismatch. Values are transient; only exact privacy-safe name/tool/mount/process/broker digests are retained.

No candidate-controlled PATH lookup occurs in the privileged parent.

root_owned_path_contract.rule: the staging/runtime roots must be absent at PREPARE entry, be created through exact absolute /usr/bin/sudo and /usr/bin/install argv without a symlink or preexisting inode, and retain these owners/modes. The source and installed evaluator are regular nonsymlink files with the activated seal digest. Any stale path, owner/mode drift, hardlink, symlink, bind alias, helper drift, or post-publication byte change blocks authority.

protected_execution_namespace_contract.protected_mount_rule: before any lane command, the privileged parent creates a private-recursive mount namespace and a child PID namespace with a new private /proc. It bind-mounts and recursively remounts read-only the exact staged directory, runtime directory, detached /tmp/fc01-control worktree, candidate-root/fc01-control checkout source, and the canonical aggregate of every resolved runtime/toolchain executable root from the environment receipt. Setup sandboxes require the first four plus every already-installed input tool root; a step whose sole purpose installs a missing tool may write only its exact declared installation targets, which are immediately post-hashed and protected for all later steps. All backing descriptors are closed before exec. A control-evaluator lane may expose only the exact precreated setup/result output files parsed from its immutable command as individually writable bind mounts; the sealed evaluator is the sole executable in that lane and the parent revokes/chowns those files root immediately after PID-namespace teardown. Every other writable exception list is empty.
protected_execution_namespace_contract.private_run_rule: the child namespace mounts a fresh size=1MiB,nodev,nosuid,noexec tmpfs on /run; /var/run resolves only to that private mount. Host Docker, containerd, systemd, D-Bus, SSH-agent, credential-agent, runner, and every other host Unix control socket are absent. The only optional socket is /run/fc01-postgres-broker.sock under the exact narrow broker contract.
protected_execution_namespace_contract.fd_rule: the command process inherits only descriptors 0,1,2 and the read-only sealed command memfd; control-evaluator output descriptors are opened only by the sealed evaluator. It receives no privileged-parent, host-socket, root-filesystem, mount-namespace, pidfd, secret, cache, artifact, OIDC, or provider descriptor.
protected_execution_namespace_contract.setup_executor_class_rule: RUNNER_NO_NEW_PRIVS uses the original runner uid/gid and an empty capability set. ROOT_BOUNDED and ROOT_BOUNDED_POSTGRES_BROKER use uid/euid/gid 0 with the exact ROOT_CAPTURED ceiling; only the latter exposes the phase-specific broker operations. Every class uses no_new_privs, private mount/PID/proc/run, the protected read-only mounts, sealed command memfd, closed environment, bounded output, and mandatory teardown. No setup step may select or broaden its class.
protected_execution_namespace_contract.rule: the privileged parent constructs mounts, private /run, optional broker, and network denial before dropping to the exact child identity/capability ceiling. The child cannot remount protected bytes, observe or signal the parent through /proc, connect to host control sockets, regain an absent bounding capability, elevate through a setuid executable, or retain a descendant after namespace teardown. A denial/identity/mount/capability/socket observation mismatch is a protected-sandbox integrity failure and can never be represented as an ordinary test failure or PASS.

postgres_broker_contract.rule: the privileged parent opens the host Docker socket before replacing /run, retains it only in a nondumpable sealed broker process, and closes it in every command child. The root-owned client digest is derived from the sealed evaluator and prepended to PATH only for a PostgreSQL profile. During a lane the broker accepts only the exact psql argv shape against the one disposable digest-pinned service and a syntactically bounded database name; stdin SQL is forwarded but retained only as a SHA-256/byte count, and no host path, mount, exec program, container create/start/stop/copy/inspect, other service, or raw response is authorized. Setup phases expose only their exact closed operation list. All requests are sequenced and privacy-minimized in the sandbox receipt. Direct /usr/bin/docker or raw socket use fails because every host socket is hidden.

sealed_command_memfd_contract.rule: the privileged evaluator opens and reads the GitHub command file before entering the child namespace, applies the one permitted transport-LF normalization, proves exact canonical bytes and digest, copies those bytes once into a new anonymous memfd, applies all four seals, closes the original command-file descriptor, and executes only the sealed fd. A disk path, unsealed descriptor, altered bytes, second read, second execution, or candidate-writable command source is forbidden.

output_capture_contract.rule: the privileged parent drains stdout/stderr through root-held pipes while computing total byte counts and digests. Bytes up to the exact caps remain only in root-private runtime until deterministic parsing; any extra byte is an integrity failure, terminates the PID namespace, and cannot yield FAIL_COMPLETE or PASS. Raw bytes are deleted before publishing the minimized bundle.

teardown_contract.rule: the namespace PID-1 reaper records the authority child exit, closes the broker, sends SIGTERM to every remaining namespace process, waits at most ten monotonic seconds, SIGKILLs and reaps any remainder, and exits only after the surviving count is zero. Namespace destruction precedes post-identity checks. The privileged parent then rehashes the staged evaluator, authority binding, control worktree/source, candidate HEAD/tree and tracked diff, broker log, setup journal, and all protected mount sources. It atomically records teardown facts outside child reach. A timeout, unkillable descendant, protected mutation, control drift, evaluator drift, tracked candidate mutation, broker-policy violation, or missing post-check blocks publication; cleanup failure is never downgraded to an ordinary lane failure.

self_test_negative_contract.rule: the sealed --self-test implementation and every executor-mode unit fixture enter the real protected namespace and attempt one non-destructive write/create against staged evaluator, detached control, and authority-binding targets plus one connect/stat attempt against the host Docker socket. Each filesystem attempt must fail EROFS or EACCES, the socket must be absent or inaccessible, and every pre/post identity must match. A writable target, visible host socket, skipped case, mocked-only result, cleanup residue, or caller-authored PASS fails self-test and blocks workflow generation.

sealed_runtime_lifecycle_contract.bundle_rule: when PREPARE, every exact setup sandbox, lane entry, protected execution, and teardown completed with intact root-owned state, the privileged finalizer rehashes its own sealed bytes and all state, parses bounded output, and creates a fresh root-private directory containing a canonical PASS or FAIL_COMPLETE bundle manifest plus the exact gate/lane output registry. It deletes raw stdout/stderr after derivation, fsyncs every regular nonsymlink file and directory, atomically publishes minimized-bundle once as root-owned 0555/0444, and verifies its digest after publication. Upload-artifact can read but not mutate it. If PREPARE/setup fails before lane entry, finalizer cannot fabricate environment/execution/sandbox bytes, exits nonzero, and the missing path makes upload fail. The artifact is unique and one-day retained; an external authenticated importer binds its provider ID/digest and commits bytes add-only. No job push, product/control ref mutation, raw log/JUnit/stdout, environment value, token, provider/user payload, database coordinate, browser body/URL/header, unlisted file, or post-finalization byte change is accepted.

workflow_execution_surface_contract.lane_run_rule: each active job has exactly one LANE_RUN between PREPARE_CI_RUNTIME and FINALIZE_CI_RUNTIME. PASS status requires lane exit zero; FAIL_COMPLETE status permits only a nonzero ordinary command outcome while every integrity/teardown value still passes. Any output overflow, host socket, unsealed command, protected/control/evaluator/toolchain/candidate tracked mutation, broker violation, missing negative, namespace/capability drift, or survivor makes this receipt non-authoritative and forbids a bundle.

m00_call_budget.rule: call_categories are the exact required_category_order bijection and no fourth category is permitted. artifact_generation has minimum_calls>=1; frozen_quality_judge has minimum_calls>=2 because any M00 PASS requires distinct initial and final judge events; artifact_repair has minimum_calls=0 and an exact approved maximum because the single repair event may be deterministic or may use bounded provider calls. All three use the required PROVIDER_AUTHENTICATED observation mode. All minima/maxima are int-not-bool with 0<=minimum<=maximum; minimum_total_calls and maximum_total_calls equal their sums. The runtime lifecycle assigns every observed forward call exactly once to the matching create, initial-judge, repair, or final-judge event and reconciles the resulting category counts to these bounds. Minima are PASS-only: every PASS event meets its event minimum and aggregate PASS meets every category/total minimum. A FAIL event retains its complete observed call prefix, which may be empty when failure occurred before launch; within a multi-call event zero or more calls may PASS, at most the last observed call may FAIL, and no later call exists for that event. The sole reached REPAIR event consumes every artifact_repair call and its total lies in the frozen [minimum_calls,maximum_calls] range; minimum zero permits a deterministic repair with no provider call. The frozen native NO_REPAIR_NEEDED repair_count=0 path lacks JUDGE_FINAL and is typed FAIL, not an exception to the two-judge PASS rule; another repair_count=0 failure retains its actual shorter call prefix. A PASS cannot report zero/one judge call, omit an observed provider repair call, add a fourth category, or relabel a provider call as sealed-local. No payload, prompt, response, token, secret, user content, or provider raw data is stored

m00_component_evidence.fact_availability_rule: The prerequisite maps have exactly the required/optional fact catalogs and closed tokens above. m00_component_evidence.artifact_hash_projection_rule: artifact_kind equals artifact_kind_by_category. m00_component_evidence.rule: component_category, artifact_kind, observed_at, result, and reference digest exactly equal the parent manifest row. FAIL retains all attempted slots and is derived if any required source is FAIL, PARTIAL, or UNAVAILABLE or any required fact fails its PASS expectation; it never fabricates or suppresses another captured source. The optional LangSmith observation/fact is excluded from PASS authority. NOT_PRODUCED has empty source refs, component_attempt_state=NOT_PRODUCED, not_produced_reason=NOT_PRODUCED_DUE_TO_UNREACHED_PREREQUISITE, and result/status NOT_PRODUCED_DUE_TO_FAILED_STAGE. ATTEMPTED has null not_produced_reason and result PASS or FAIL. raw payload/content flag is false.

m00_runtime_observation_bundle.artifact_and_quality_role_identity_rule: Role-indexed classes are never collapsed. M00 PASS requires repair_count=1; initial/final quality-run aliases, initial/final quality-attempt aliases, initial/final artifact-publication aliases, and initial/final artifact SHA-256 values are all AVAILABLE and pairwise distinct within each role pair. On any FAIL, including repair_count=1 failure before final publication/judge, each role's AVAILABLE/NOT_CREATED/NOT_OBSERVED state and digest are derived independently from the reached signed lifecycle, native facts, publication facts, and held artifacts. Distinctness is required for an initial/final pair only when both are AVAILABLE; an unavailable role has null alias/digest and its exact reason and can never borrow the other role. The special frozen no-repair shape applies iff native_runtime_result=NO_REPAIR_NEEDED and CREATE_INITIAL/JUDGE_INITIAL are PASS: exactly the initial quality run/attempt and one INITIAL_ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION/hash are retained, FINAL_QUALITY_RUN, FINAL_QUALITY_ATTEMPT, and FINAL_ARTIFACT_PUBLICATION are NOT_CREATED, final artifact SHA is null, and NO_REPAIR_PATH_MISSING_REQUIRED_FINAL_JUDGE is required. Another repair_count=0 failure derives whatever initial roles were actually reached, marks the exact later suffix NOT_OBSERVED_DUE_TO_PRIOR_BOUND_FAILURE, and must not synthesize the no-repair finding. An emitter may not alias the initial publication into an absent final role or upgrade any incomplete path to PASS.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.component_attempt_state_rule: component_attempt_state_rows are exactly the ten m00_runtime_finalization_receipt.required_component_categories in sequence order. prerequisite_event_sequences are the exact lifecycle sequence projection of m00_component_evidence.component_availability_prerequisite_by_category; satisfied_prerequisite_event_sequences are its reached subset. ATTEMPTED iff all event and artifact prerequisites are satisfied, has null not_produced_reason, attempted_component_source_slot_ids equal every required catalog slot plus the present optional slot, and exact ATTEMPTED status. NOT_PRODUCED iff at least one prerequisite is unmet, has NOT_PRODUCED_DUE_TO_UNREACHED_PREREQUISITE, empty attempted slot IDs, and exact NOT_PRODUCED status. Rows are derived independently; category order never creates a failure suffix.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.aggregate_finding_rule: aggregate_failure_rows are the exact deterministic, deduplicated projection of authoritative evidence and derived bounds. Each authoritative FAIL source or call export contributes exactly one primary finding selected by authenticated_source_failure_signal_to_finding_id[failure_signal_code]. Its independently retained failed facts are hashed together into that row rather than suppressed or expanded into caller-selected findings. Each FAIL lifecycle event with both provenance digests null contributes direct_lifecycle_failure_signal_to_finding_id[failure_signal_code]. A provenance-bearing FAIL lifecycle event contributes no duplicate lifecycle finding because the referenced failed source/call row is already authoritative. PARTIAL and each UNAVAILABLE domain select exactly nonpass_source_result_to_finding_id. Exact nonzero unclassified/dropped coverage counters contribute their same-named finding even when the coverage envelope's primary failure signal is another code; normalized evidence deduplicates an identical counter/source row. Identity conflicts, ATTEMPTED component expectation failures, call/effect minimum/maximum/count/spend violations, mechanical mismatch, unbound calls, clock/window overrun, and the conditional frozen no-repair defect contribute their exact named rows. The sole optional trace_correlation_evidence/0004/LANGSMITH_SUPPLEMENTAL_CORRELATION source, when present, is retained as a non-authoritative diagnostic: its absence or PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE result creates no aggregate row, changes no component/terminal result, and never satisfies or replaces a required fact. A component with component_attempt_state=NOT_PRODUCED is consequence/suffix evidence tied to an unreached prerequisite and creates no fresh COMPONENT_EXPECTATION_FAILURE; only ATTEMPTED components and their required facts can do so. NO_REPAIR_PATH_MISSING_REQUIRED_FINAL_JUDGE exists iff native_runtime_result=NO_REPAIR_NEEDED with CREATE_INITIAL/JUDGE_INITIAL PASS and the frozen missing-final-judge suffix; another repair_count=0 failure does not synthesize it. Rows sort by precedence_rank, failure_stage, finding_id, normalized_value_sha256 and are one-based. Each row's failure_signal_code equals aggregate_finding_to_failure_signal_code[finding_id], and every condition/terminal/trigger/transition/stage/invariant field equals failure_signal_derivation_map[failure_signal_code]. Aggregate-only findings such as spend or call maximum overage are required even when every signed source export reports PASS; callers cannot choose aggregate result. failing_invariant_ids is the sorted unique row projection. failure_stage is the first row under this order. The terminal condition is the lowest precedence_rank present under abort_condition_contract, and the FAIL incident binds all row facts.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.unbound_forward_call_rule: unbound_forward_call_registry_sequences is the exact ascending unique registry-sequence projection of every FORWARD_M00_ATTEMPT CALL_EVENT not referenced by exactly one reached lifecycle event's call_registry_sequences. PASS requires []; FAIL retains the complete projection and derives one UNBOUND_FORWARD_CALL finding per sequence. Cleanup/safety-restoration calls are intentionally excluded from both lifecycle ownership and this array. An out-of-range, duplicate, non-call, cleanup, or caller-selected sequence is invalid rather than evidence.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.native_runtime_terminal_rule: native_runtime_result and native_runtime_status are an exact signed native-terminal projection, never caller or aggregate fields. When LANGGRAPH_DECK_DESIGN_LIFT_RUNTIME was reached, its retained terminal fact/event supplies PASS, FAIL, or NO_REPAIR_NEEDED and every independently reached persistence/canvas terminal fact must agree. When the first frozen lifecycle failure occurred before that native source or any provider/call existed, a FAIL lifecycle event with both provenance digests null and one direct_pre_provider_lifecycle_failure_signal_code_values token deterministically supplies native_runtime_result=FAIL and native_runtime_status=FAIL_NATIVE_RUNTIME_TERMINAL; no native source row or fact is invented. A source-provenance lifecycle failure also yields native FAIL when its signed native terminal is reached. native_runtime_status always equals native_runtime_status_by_result. These fields describe only the frozen product's native terminal: native PASS may still become bundle FAIL because of call/spend/effect/component findings, and native NO_REPAIR_NEEDED always becomes bundle FAIL with the required missing-final-judge finding. No aggregate result/status is written back into a native fact.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.capture_attestation_projection_rule: capture_attestation copies the exact verified transient whole-capture attestation fields, adds signature_sha256 as SHA-256 of the decoded signature bytes, and otherwise has no extra field. whole_capture_attester_sequence/attester/key/algorithm equal the D2-frozen aggregate trust row; signed_at lies in its validity interval. signed_projection_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON UTF-8 [FC01_M00_SIGNED_RUNTIME_CAPTURE_V1,whole_capture_attester_sequence,attester_id,attestation_key_id,attestation_algorithm,signed_at,d2_consumption_ref,candidate_sha,candidate_tree,attempt_id,synthetic_scope_alias,capture_started_at,capture_ended_at,source_exports,lifecycle_event_exports], and signature verifies that exact digest under RSA-PSS-SHA256/MGF1-SHA256/salt32. Thus signer/key/algorithm/signed_at are cryptographically bound rather than mutable verification selectors. coverage_started_at/ended_at equal the signed capture interval. This retained public signature proof is immutable evidence, while [d2_consumption.sha256,attempt_id] remains the narrower one-use key.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.d2_chain_and_overlay_rule: d2_packet, d2_approval, d2_consumption, and d2_frozen_inputs are a fully replayed exact add-only FC01-D2 packet/presentation/approval/consumption chain at evidence_head, including one-use, clock, zero-prior-attempt, candidate, and frozen-input validation. authenticated_export_trust_registry equals d2_frozen_inputs.authenticated_export_trust_registry. deployed_identity_overlay is not caller identity data: it is the exact canonical reference at d2_packet.gate_evidence.provider_identity_overlay and deeply loads provider_identity_overlay:FC01-D2. candidate_sha/tree equal that packet, consumption, frozen inputs, deployed overlay, and the explicit canonical --candidate-repo Git object. Any mismatch is SOURCE_CONFLICT/BLOCKED control-head drift before evidence emission.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.attempt_identity_rule: d2_consumption is the unique consumed FC01-D2 approval and is the sole pre-action prepare seal. attempt_id is the lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON over [schema_version, amendment_id, d2_consumption.path, d2_consumption.sha256, candidate_sha, candidate_tree]; correlation_alias is the lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON over [FC01_M00_CORRELATION_V1, attempt_id, synthetic_scope_alias]. identity_projection_rows are the exact required_identity_classes order and preserve distinct initial/final quality-run, quality-attempt, and artifact-publication roles plus thread/task/build/run, BuildMutationTransaction, Builder event stream, and D2 synthetic scope. AVAILABLE has nonnull alias/digest and null reason. Except for SYNTHETIC_SCOPE, an AVAILABLE row has nonnull source_registry_sequence selecting the first available matching signed source under identity_source_precedence_by_class; every later available claim must equal it. SYNTHETIC_SCOPE is always AVAILABLE, equals synthetic_scope_alias, derives only from D2, and has source_registry_sequence JSON null. NOT_CREATED or NOT_OBSERVED has null alias, digest, and source_registry_sequence plus the exact matching reason. An unavailable or synthetic row cannot point at a source; an available non-synthetic row cannot omit or caller-select one. Conflicting available claims derive IDENTITY_PROJECTION_CONFLICT. No raw identifier, user identity, coordinate, endpoint, credential, or secret is stored.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.source_registry_rule: source_registry_rows are the deterministic projection of the one verified signed capture; no unsigned or finalizer-invented source row is permitted. Every row's source_attester_sequence selects the exact D2 trust-registry authorization for domain/key/component slot/projection group; source_envelope_id and source_envelope_sha256 are lowercase SHA-256, globally unique, and equal the signed envelope's canonical digest. The SEALED_PPTX_PACKAGE_VALIDATOR is a D2-authorized whole-capture-signed SEALED_LOCAL component row whose minimized facts and envelope must also equal the finalizer's independent held-byte recomputation before staging. NATIVE_LIFECYCLE rows are exactly the ordered set union of actual native source envelopes referenced by any lifecycle event, filtered into required_native_lifecycle_source_keys order, with each envelope once and no orphan native export. A PASS event references its complete required_native_sources_by_event_kind set; a FAIL event references only its actually observed ordered subset, possibly empty; NOT_OBSERVED references none. A shared aggregate source may be referenced by multiple reached events but has one registry row. An included native source spanning reached and unreached prerequisites may be PARTIAL under the exact per-fact availability map. The D2 trust registry still authorizes the complete preaction catalog even when unexecuted sources are absent from capture/registry. Exactly one CALL_SOURCE_COVERAGE and every required EFFECT_SOURCE_COVERAGE class has one row, including a signed UNAVAILABLE row when authenticated coverage cannot be exported. A COMPONENT_SOURCE row exists only for an ATTEMPTED category and its exact component_source_slot_id; all attempted required slots have one signed row, while NOT_PRODUCED categories have none. Every observed call/effect has one row. Full-coverage rows span the exact capture/bundle interval and event rows lie inside it. Every PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL row, including the sealed validator, has canonical capture_started_at <= started_at < ended_at <= capture_ended_at; UNAVAILABLE has both timestamps null and its finding observed_at derives as capture_ended_at. PASS has failure_signal_code null. FAIL has exactly one allowed source failure signal consistent with its one-or-more retained failed facts/status while every independent fact remains retained. PARTIAL has PARTIAL_DUE_TO_PRIOR_BOUND_FAILURE. UNAVAILABLE has AUTHENTICATED_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE and the exact unavailable reason; unavailable_reason is null otherwise. PROVIDER_AUTHENTICATED observed rows have a provider tuple and null local fields; provider UNAVAILABLE retains its signed envelope but null provider/local tuple. SEALED_LOCAL is permitted only for the sealed PPTX slot, has null provider/group fields, exact local reason, and the activated evaluator ref, and cannot be UNAVAILABLE when its ATTEMPTED prerequisite holds. Provider tuple reuse is forbidden for call/effect/coverage. For native/provider component only, a tuple may repeat solely under the closed authorized projection-group rule with distinct envelopes/slots/digests. No tuple or group inflates a count.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.source_registry_digest_rule: For each row, minimized_projection_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_MINIMIZED_SOURCE_PROJECTION_V1,source_domain,source_key,component_source_slot_id,source_attester_sequence,source_envelope_id,source_envelope_sha256,observer_mode,coverage_started_at,coverage_ended_at,observed_event_count,opaque_provider_receipt_id,opaque_provider_receipt_sha256,provider_receipt_projection_group_id,failure_signal_code,result,provider_receipt_null_reason,sealed_local_observer_ref,native_identity_aliases,native_fact_rows,unavailable_reason,raw_payload_or_user_private_or_secret_content_stored,status]. source_registry_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_SOURCE_REGISTRY_V1,attempt_id,source_registry_rows] after assigning the exact one-based registry order. Both are lowercase 64-hex and recomputed, never caller digests. Registry sequence is excluded only from each row's minimized digest and included through the ordered outer rows; no raw payload or final emitted path/time participates.

native_lifecycle_precursor_contract.failure_source_key_derivation_rule: failure_source_key_or_null is the exact source_key selected by the lifecycle failure precedence when a FAIL event is caused by the first failing actual native source in required-native order; it is JSON null for PASS, NOT_OBSERVED, final-failing-call provenance, and direct pre-provider lifecycle failure. It is selected from ordered source_keys before any source envelope is hashed and later must equal the source key at failure_source_envelope_sha256's same-position source_envelope_sha256s entry. The key is pre-hash semantic provenance; the envelope digest is excluded from the precursor.
native_lifecycle_precursor_contract.manifest_rule: For each lifecycle event in exact event_kind_sequences_by_repair_count order, p_i is SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_NATIVE_LIFECYCLE_PRECURSOR_EVENT_V1,attempt_id,sequence,event_slot_id,event_kind,started_at,ended_at,source_keys,call_envelope_sha256s,failure_signal_code,failure_source_key_or_null,failure_call_envelope_sha256,artifact_sha256,artifact_null_reason,not_observed_reason,result,status]. native_lifecycle_precursor_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_NATIVE_LIFECYCLE_PRECURSOR_MANIFEST_V1,attempt_id,[p_i in exact event order]]. attempt_id is repeated outside and inside every event through the validated event_slot_id/explicit term; source_keys are the exact ordered semantic ownership projection. Source/call indices, source envelope hashes, failure_source_envelope_sha256, stable_event_projection_sha256, and registry sequences are excluded. Call envelope hashes, every failure_signal_code, and the derived failure source key are known before native source-envelope hashing and introduce no digest dependency.
native_lifecycle_precursor_contract.fact_comparison_rule: Whenever one of fact_id_by_source_key's facts is independently available, its SHA256 value is PASS iff it exactly equals native_lifecycle_precursor_manifest_sha256 and FAIL iff it differs; NOT_OBSERVED is permitted only when that fact's own prerequisite is false, while whole-source UNAVAILABLE retains the export-unavailable override. This comparison applies on aggregate PASS, native/source FAIL, direct lifecycle FAIL, ordinary repair_count=0 FAIL, and frozen NO_REPAIR_NEEDED aggregate FAIL. Other native_pass_expectation_by_source_key entries remain aggregate-PASS-only.
native_lifecycle_precursor_contract.fixture_mutation_rule: Self-tests include repair_count=1 PASS, native-source FAIL, final-failing-call FAIL, direct pre-provider FAIL, ordinary repair_count=0 FAIL, and frozen no-repair shapes. Mutating any precursor term without updating the independently signed native digest fact must make that fact FAIL; mutating only a source index/hash or failure_source_envelope_sha256 leaves the precursor unchanged but must change or invalidate the full stable event projection; mutating a mapped native digest fact cannot induce a fixed point and is retained as typed source FAIL.

m00_runtime_observation_bundle.native_projection_rule: native_identity_aliases retains the exact availability-aware role-indexed rows from the signed envelope on every source. NATIVE_LIFECYCLE uses transient_observation_bundle_contract.native_identity_classes_by_source_key; COMPONENT_SOURCE uses identity_classes_by_component_source_slot_id; CALL_SOURCE_COVERAGE uses its minimal thread/scope class set; CALL_EVENT uses identity_classes_by_call_event_kind so create does not demand quality identities; effect rows use identity_classes_by_effect_source_domain. Each AVAILABLE alias digest is SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_OPAQUE_IDENTITY_PROJECTION_V1,identity_class,opaque_alias]; unavailable rows have null alias/digest and exact reason. Shared available classes agree with the top identity row. Only NATIVE_LIFECYCLE retains native_fact_rows; typed child receipts own nonnative facts. Native fact order/types and each fact's availability derive exactly from transient_observation_bundle_contract.native_fact_contract_by_source_key and native_fact_availability_prerequisite_by_source_key. Native PASS has every fact observed PASS. Native FAIL has one or more observed FAIL facts while retaining every later/earlier independently known PASS or FAIL value (including false/zero); only a fact with its own unmet prerequisite is NOT_OBSERVED. Native PARTIAL has no FAIL, at least one observed PASS, and at least one independently justified NOT_OBSERVED fact without a contiguity requirement. UNAVAILABLE has every fact NOT_OBSERVED with export-unavailable reason. Other PASS expectations in native_pass_expectation_by_source_key apply only when bundle result is PASS, but EVENT_SEQUENCE_SHA256, STAGE_ORDER_SHA256, and ORDERED_EVENT_STREAM_SHA256 always compare to native_lifecycle_precursor_contract whenever independently available: equality is PASS, inequality is retained FAIL, and NOT_OBSERVED requires an unmet prerequisite. Native terminal facts derive native_runtime_result/status only, not aggregate bundle result/status. The precursor manifest binds exact attempt/event identity, time, ordered source-key ownership, call envelopes, pre-hash failure cause/key, artifact/null shape, result, and status before native source envelopes exist. The unchanged full stable_event_projection_sha256 is recomputed only after source envelopes and exact failure-source digest exist; it remains the post-envelope ownership/provenance hash and is never a native source fact expectation. A missing/failed native source can never be replaced by a local assertion.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.lifecycle_rule: lifecycle_event_rows equal the exact event_kind_sequences_by_repair_count order, with event_slot_id={attempt_id}/{sequence:04d}/{event_kind}. Before any native source envelope is hashed, native_lifecycle_precursor_contract recomputes the ordered attempt-bound precursor manifest from event identity/time, ordered source_keys, call envelopes, pre-hash failure signal/source-key/call provenance, artifact/null shape, result, and status. Only source/call indices, source envelope hashes, the raw failure-source envelope digest, the post-envelope stable hash, and registry sequences are excluded from that precursor. After native source envelopes exist, source_envelope_sha256s and call_envelope_sha256s preserve signed capture ownership; stable_event_projection_sha256 remains SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_STABLE_LIFECYCLE_EVENT_V1,event_slot_id,event_kind,started_at,ended_at,source_envelope_sha256s,call_envelope_sha256s,failure_signal_code,failure_source_envelope_sha256,failure_call_envelope_sha256,artifact_sha256,artifact_null_reason,not_observed_reason,result,status]. Registry sequence arrays are later same-order bijective projections and never enter that stable hash. A reached PASS/FAIL event has canonical capture_started_at <= started_at < ended_at <= capture_ended_at, null not_observed_reason, and status from lifecycle_status_by_observed_result. PASS has source envelopes exactly required_native_sources_by_event_kind[event_kind] in that order, all three failure fields JSON null, and its exact calls/minima. FAIL has the exact actually observed ordered subset of allowed required native sources, which may be empty, plus zero or more PASS calls followed by at most one final FAIL call. FAIL has one lifecycle_failure_signal_code_values token. If a final FAIL call exists, failure_call_envelope_sha256 is that call envelope, failure_source_envelope_sha256 is null, and the event code equals its SOURCE_* failure signal. Otherwise, if any actual native source result is FAIL, failure_source_envelope_sha256 is the first such envelope in required-native order, the call provenance is null, and the event code equals that source's SOURCE_* signal. Otherwise both provenance digests are null and the event code is exactly one direct_pre_provider_lifecycle_failure_signal_code_values LIFECYCLE_* token selected from the signed direct stage outcome; the condition/terminal/stage/invariant derive from that token without fabricating a child source. A provenance-bearing FAIL cannot use LIFECYCLE_* and a direct FAIL cannot use SOURCE_*. PASS and NOT_OBSERVED have all failure fields null. A NOT_OBSERVED event additionally has started_at=ended_at=artifact_sha256=JSON null, empty source/call envelope and registry arrays, one exact lifecycle_not_observed_reason_values token, artifact_null_reason equal that token, and status from lifecycle_status_by_not_observed_reason. artifact_role_by_lifecycle_event_kind is exact: CREATE_INITIAL/JUDGE_INITIAL bind the produced INITIAL artifact; REPAIR/JUDGE_FINAL/AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_REVIEW bind the produced FINAL artifact. A reached event carries that role's exact held/publication/native/component digest with artifact_null_reason null whenever it exists; a FAIL may use null only when not produced, with NOT_PRODUCED_DUE_TO_FAILED_STAGE. Initial/final roles cannot be swapped, aliased, or invented. M00 PASS requires repair_count=1, every event PASS, distinct judges/roles/artifacts, and all PASS-only call rules. Every forward call belongs to exactly one reached event; cleanup/safety rows belong to none. Iff native_runtime_result=NO_REPAIR_NEEDED and CREATE_INITIAL/JUDGE_INITIAL PASS, those events bind the single initial artifact while JUDGE_FINAL/review use the exact frozen no-repair null suffix and require the no-repair finding. Any other repair_count=0 failure retains its actual first FAIL, possibly with zero source/call rows and direct provenance, marks later events prior-bound NOT_OBSERVED, and has no synthetic no-repair finding. No caller inserts a source, call, artifact, judge, or rerun.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.aggregate_counter_and_result_rule: actual_call_counts_by_category has exactly artifact_generation, frozen_quality_judge, artifact_repair and is recomputed from unique CALL_EVENT rows; actual_total_calls is their sum and actual_spend_usd is the finite nonnegative exact cost sum. observed_effect_event_count, unexpected_effect_count, operator_database_mutations, private_reads, voice_calls, and raw_content_recorded recompute from EFFECT_EVENT rows and exhaustive coverage. unclassified_source_record_count and dropped_source_record_count recompute from signed coverage facts/findings, never caller counters. native_runtime_result/status derive only native lifecycle rows. Bundle result/status are independently derived: PASS iff capture signature/trust/identity/lifecycle/component/call/effect/mechanical closure all pass, every D2 minimum/maximum/spend/effect bound passes, no aggregate finding exists, PASS required values hold, and repair_count=1; otherwise representable evidence is FAIL_COMPLETE_EVIDENCE with exact nonempty aggregate_failure_rows, failure_stage, and failing_invariant_ids. An all-PASS source set with a derived call/spend/effect overage is still FAIL. An unrepresentable trust/signature/path/chain ambiguity blocks before emission rather than becoming PASS.
m00_runtime_observation_bundle.one_use_rule: matching_attempt_count=1 and prior_matching_attempt_count=retry_count=0 are exhaustive over the exact synthetic/native identity mapping and entire post-consumption capture interval. The primary replay key is [d2_consumption.sha256,attempt_id]; exactly one transient capture, capture signature, bundle, finalization, manifest, and terminal may consume it regardless of signer/key rotation, signature randomness, or changed projection. Attester/key/projection digests are retained audit fields but never widen the replay key. The global evaluator rejects every orphan attempt-scoped receipt, second capture/bundle/attempt, alternate output tree, or silent rerun and requires the bundle to be reachable from the singleton terminal through the manifest and finalization receipt.

m00_runtime_finalization_receipt.finalizer_invocation_rule: finalizer_implementation_ref is exactly the activated sealed Amendment B evaluator reference, and its sha256 equals finalizer_runtime_identity.evaluator_sha256. finalizer_invocation_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_FINALIZER_INVOCATION_V1,finalizer_algorithm_id,finalizer_implementation_ref,finalizer_runtime_identity,d2_packet,d2_approval,d2_consumption,d2_frozen_inputs,authenticated_export_trust_registry,deployed_identity_overlay,candidate_sha,candidate_tree,attempt_id,runtime_observation_bundle_ref.capture_attestation.signed_projection_sha256,runtime_observation_bundle_ref.capture_attestation.signature_sha256,finalizer_invocation_path_identity_rows,evidence_head_commit,evidence_head_tree,input_rows,initial_artifact_absence_sentinel_selection,final_artifact_absence_sentinel_selection]. finalizer_invocation_path_identity_rows have cli_contract.finalizer_invocation_path_identity_row_exact_fields/order and bind canonical control/candidate/runtime/transient/output target paths, held parent/target identities, and the requested published basename. input_rows are exact immutable basename/device/inode/sha256/byte_count/presence rows, and the capture digests come from the already verified signature. The projection excludes created/updated times, mutable journal state, staging_tree_sha256, journal_basename, staging_basename, and transient_root_tombstone_basename; those names are deterministic functions of attempt/invocation and cannot feed their own digest.
m00_runtime_finalization_receipt.journal_genesis_rule: journal_genesis_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON [FC01_M00_FINALIZER_JOURNAL_GENESIS_V1,attempt_id,finalizer_invocation_sha256,d2_consumption.sha256,candidate_sha,candidate_tree,runtime_parent_device,runtime_parent_inode,runtime_basename,journal_basename,transient_root_parent_device,transient_root_parent_inode,transient_root_device,transient_root_inode,transient_root_basename,transient_root_tombstone_basename,output_parent_device,output_parent_inode,staging_basename,published_basename,input_rows]. It is immutable after PREPARED and is the only journal digest retained inside 07. The mutable state hash chain, inventory rows, and final staging_tree_sha256 remain external to staged evidence bytes, avoiding self-reference through 07/08/09; CLI success separately requires verified COMPLETE.

mechanical_validation_contract.rule: The finalizer itself, using only its activated sealed Python standard-library bytes, validates the held final.pptx descriptor; no candidate module, macro, plugin, shell command, LibreOffice, network source, or caller boolean executes. It first binds the exact file SHA-256 to the authenticated final-artifact publication and the signed SEALED_PPTX_PACKAGE_VALIDATOR export, enforces all archive/entry bounds, reruns the complete validator, and requires exact equality with that signed source's minimized facts/result/status/envelope before staging or deleting the artifact. ZIP entries are unique normalized relative POSIX paths with no absolute path, dot segment, traversal, backslash alternate, NUL/control character, encryption, device/FIFO/socket, symlink, duplicate normalized name, unsupported compression, or overlapping/invalid central-directory metadata. Uncompressed sizes and ratios are bounded. Required root parts exist. Before parsing, every XML part is bounded and rejects DOCTYPE, ENTITY, XInclude, and encoding tricks; ElementTree parses it without external resolution. Every relationship has TargetMode exactly Internal (or an omitted attribute meaning Internal), a recognized non-forbidden relationship type, a normalized in-archive target, an existing declared target part, and no external URI. Any TargetMode External, unrecognized relationship type, forbidden relationship-type suffix, macro/VBA, ActiveX, OLE/package embedding, executable/script part, forbidden content type, forbidden path prefix, or forbidden filename suffix is a mechanical failure. OPC content-type defaults/overrides, package relationships, presentation slide IDs, presentation relationships, slide parts, slide relationships, layouts, masters, themes, notes, charts, permitted embedded media, and every internal relationship target are closed and coherent. The presentation contains at least one unique slide and all referenced slide/master/layout/theme relationships are internally coherent. PPTX_CONTAINER_VALID is true exactly when the bounded ZIP/OPC/security checks pass. NATIVE_ARTIFACT_VALID is true exactly when the presentation/slide/native relationship graph passes. transient_observation_bundle_contract.independent_fact_availability_rule: The native and generic prerequisite maps have exactly the fact IDs and order of native_fact_contract_by_source_key and generic_fact_ids_by_source_domain. EFFECT_SOURCE_COVERAGE SOURCE_CLASS is PASS iff it is the selected required source class; OBSERVED_EVENT_COUNT is PASS iff it equals the exact typed effect-count sum for that class; UNCLASSIFIED_EVENT_COUNT and DROPPED_OBSERVATION_COUNT are PASS iff zero; STATUS is PASS iff PASS_COMPLETE_COVERAGE and otherwise the exact typed failure status. Source result then derives over all rows under source_export_count_rule; a caller cannot choose a fact result.

No wall-clock, file time, caller timestamp, or invented interval fills an unavailable source.
transient_observation_bundle_contract.source_export_count_rule: Every PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL NATIVE_LIFECYCLE, COMPONENT_SOURCE, or CALL_EVENT export has observed_event_count=1. UNAVAILABLE has zero. Available CALL/EFFECT coverage facts are all observed together, so observed/unclassified/dropped/status counters remain simultaneous even when one or more predicates fail. Captured false/zero values and multiple failures are retained. Transient exports already contain every emitted signed row, including the sealed validator; no unsigned row is inserted. Sequence is one-based/gapless; each repeated ordinal is <=9999. Envelope hash is the final deterministic tie breaker. No caller order, path, provider ID, artifact name, or created_at can change the result. Lifecycle export indices are remapped bijectively to final registry sequences without changing signed ownership.
transient_observation_bundle_contract.lifecycle_event_shape_rule: Each lifecycle_event_export is the exact signed precursor of one runtime lifecycle row. A reached PASS/FAIL event has canonical capture_started_at <= started_at < ended_at <= capture_ended_at, null not_observed_reason, positive unique in-range source_export_indices/call_export_indices whose source_keys and envelope arrays agree in the same order, and artifact role/hash under artifact_role_by_lifecycle_event_kind. PASS has source_keys/indices exactly required_native_sources_by_event_kind[event_kind], all three failure fields null, and status PASS_AUTHENTICATED_LIFECYCLE_EVENT. FAIL has the exact actually observed ordered subset of those allowed sources, possibly empty, its complete chronological call prefix, status FAIL_COMPLETE_EVIDENCE, and one lifecycle failure code/provenance selected exactly by the runtime lifecycle_rule: final failing call's SOURCE_* code first, else first failing actual native source's SOURCE_* code, else one direct_pre_provider_lifecycle_failure_signal_code_values LIFECYCLE_* token with both provenance digests null. The selected provenance digest must occur in the corresponding event envelope array and its export's failure signal must equal the event code; a provenance-bearing event cannot use a direct code and a direct event cannot use a source code. If the artifact role exists, artifact_sha256 is its exact held/publication/native/component digest and artifact_null_reason is null; a reached FAIL may have null artifact only when not produced, with NOT_PRODUCED_DUE_TO_FAILED_STAGE. A NOT_OBSERVED export has started_at=ended_at=artifact_sha256=JSON null; source_keys, source_export_indices, call_export_indices, source_envelope_sha256s, and call_envelope_sha256s are all empty; all three failure fields are null; not_observed_reason is one exact lifecycle token; artifact_null_reason equals it; status comes from lifecycle_status_by_not_observed_reason. The derived failure source key is selected semantically before hashing and later cross-checks the same-position source key chosen by failure_source_envelope_sha256; source indices/hashes and the raw failure-source digest never enter the precursor. After exact envelope validation, stable_event_projection_sha256 retains the unchanged full hash over source/call envelope hashes and failure code/provenance before artifact fields. Only native NO_REPAIR_NEEDED with CREATE_INITIAL/JUDGE_INITIAL PASS uses the frozen-no-repair JUDGE_FINAL/review suffix; another repair_count=0 failure uses the prior-bound suffix after its actual first FAIL. Initial/final roles cannot be swapped, initial cannot fill an absent final role, and no time/source/call/failure/artifact may be invented.

Each independently available EVENT_SEQUENCE_SHA256, STAGE_ORDER_SHA256, or ORDERED_EVENT_STREAM_SHA256 is instead PASS iff equal to the acyclic native_lifecycle_precursor_manifest_sha256 and FAIL iff unequal on every lifecycle/result shape; NOT_OBSERVED requires its own unmet prerequisite. lifecycle_event_exports follows exact lifecycle order and lifecycle_event_shape_rule; the attempt-bound precursor is recomputed before native envelope hashes, then event_slot_id, source/call indices and envelope arrays cross-check and the unchanged full stable_event_projection_sha256 is recomputed after envelopes but before registry numbering. consumption_receipt.active_clock_snapshot_rule: embedded in the singleton consumption receipt; evaluated_at equals consumed_at; terminal_at, terminal_state, and terminal_outcome_ref are JSON null; and the evaluator recomputes it from committed seal/start/packet/presentation/approval evidence
